title: Fire-Boltt Ninja Call Pro Plus Bluetooth Calling Smart Watch, 1.83″ HD Display, AI Voice Assistant, 120+ Sports Modes, IP67 Waterproof, SpO2 & Heart Rate Monitor Smartwatch for Men & Women - Wine
bullets: 46.8mm (1.83”) Large HD Display Smartwatch – Experience a crystal-clear 1.83-inch HD display with ultra-thin bezels for an immersive visual experience. This Fire-Boltt smartwatch delivers sharp colors, smooth touch, and enhanced brightness, perfect for both indoor and outdoor use.

Bluetooth Calling Smartwatch with Dial Pad – Stay connected with Bluetooth calling and a built-in microphone and speaker. This smartwatch with call function lets you make and receive HD calls, save contacts, and access a quick dial pad right from your wrist.

AI Voice Assistant & Smart Control – Activate Google Assistant or Siri directly from your Bluetooth calling smartwatch. Control your phone, set reminders, check the weather, or play music hands-free with simple voice commands

Advanced Health & Fitness Tracking Smartwatch – Keep track of your heart rate, SpO2 (blood oxygen), sleep quality, and overall wellness with real-time monitoring. This fitness smartwatch for men and women is designed to keep you on top of your health.

100+ Sports Modes & Activity Tracker – Track your workouts like never before with 100+ sports modes including running, cycling, walking, yoga, football, basketball, and more. This smartwatch for fitness enthusiasts provides accurate calorie, step, and distance tracking

Smart Notifications & Social Media Alerts – Never miss an important update! Get instant call, SMS, WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, and email notifications on your smartwatch for Android and iPhone without reaching for your phone.

Ultra-Long Battery Life & Fast Charging – Enjoy up to 7 days of battery life on a single charge. This long battery life smartwatch ensures uninterrupted performance for daily activities, workouts, and business meetings
IP67 Waterproof Smartwatch – Designed to withstand splashes, dust, and sweat, this waterproof smartwatch is ideal for workouts, outdoor adventures, and everyday use
